description: An S-4 logistics officer must set the receiving sequence and dock windows for three routine sustainment shipments arriving at a forward base, while recording the handling controls needed for the clinic shipment.

shared_context.S1: The forward base has one receiving dock, which is available from 0800 through 1600 tomorrow.
shared_context.S2: Three shipments are expected tomorrow: Alpha generator filters, Bravo clinic consumables, and Charlie vehicle parts.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez must publish the receiving sequence and dock windows before the morning dispatch brief.
shared_context.S4: The receiving section routinely holds a pre-dispatch huddle with transportation and medical logistics to confirm shipment handling requirements.
shared_context.S5: The dock requires a documented receiving sequence, and any shipment needing special handling must have its control recorded in the dispatch plan.

PF1.text: CW2 Foster confirmed with the carrier this morning that Alpha's truck has a fixed 0800 appointment, will occupy the dock for exactly two hours, and cannot be rescheduled without losing the carrier slot; the appointment confirmation is in the transportation inbox but has not been added to the dispatch brief.

PF2.text: Lt. Morgan confirmed this morning that the clinic receiving team can accept Bravo only from 1000 to 1200, that the shipment must use powered cold-chain staging during that window, and that the dock must remain clear until 1300 for the required post-receipt sanitation; the medical handling note is still being checked against the clinic's receiving log and is not yet in the logistics plan.

acceptance_conditions: Alpha must be scheduled for the 0800 dock window.
Bravo must be scheduled for the 1000 dock window.
Charlie must be scheduled for the 1300 dock window.
The receiving order must be Alpha, Bravo, then Charlie.
The plan must lock Alpha's fixed carrier appointment.
The plan must include powered cold-chain staging for Bravo.
Bravo's medical handling fact must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'dock_appointment_lock' and c['target'] == 'Alpha' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'powered_cold_chain_staging' and c['target'] == 'Bravo' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The fixed 0800 carrier appointment and exact two-hour dock occupancy change Alpha's window to 0800, place Alpha first in the receiving order, and require an appointment-lock commitment.

Bravo's exact 1000-1200 clinic window, required powered staging, and sanitation clearance until 1300 change Bravo's slot to 1000, move Charlie to 1300, fix the receiving order, require powered staging, and provide the fact that must be cited.
